messages.text: Look, Mouse sees a horse. Listen. Horse. /h/ /ɔ/ /ɹ/ /s/ Horse. Your turn. Horse.[TEACHER_RIDE_HORSE][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, horse. A horse says neigh neigh. Listen. Neigh neigh. Your turn. Neigh neigh.[TEACHER_APPLAUD][TEACHER_RIDE_HORSE][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
How do I say the last sound in horse?
The last sound is /s/. Horse. Now, let's look at the horse. Does the horse have the cake? Say yes or no.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Maybe not. Let's watch and find out.[TEACHER_RIDE_HORSE][TEMPLATE_FINISH]

3: Does the horse have the cake
